title: Spock's reverence for the sun

tellings.quote: because he was talking about how we really don't understand the the value of our son

plain: Sometime between 1990 and 1993, at the first overseas base of a secret programme he says he served in, a contact Dan Sherman calls Spock spoke to him about the sun, saying that people "really don't understand the value" of it. Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that intercepts communications, hired him to talk with aliens, tells this as something he lived through. He also tells it in his book Above Black, and if true it would mean an otherworldly voice was teaching him a way of seeing the cosmos.
